hack.root_cause: Phishing → Private Key Compromise → Smart Contract Drain
hack.description: A single bZx developer opened a phishing email on their personal computer, had their seed phrase stolen by a malicious Word macro, and handed an attacker administrative control over two entire blockchain deployments — resulting in $55M lost across Polygon, BSC, and Ethereum.
